title: Order line matching
lead: Map order lines (store product names) to canonical items, reusing the matcher and review queue (O4).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: "HT Traders No Salt Added Black Beans 15.5 oz" has to become "black beans", or the pantry can't use it.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: 1. Ignore non-food order lines (bags, fees, tips) automatically (recommended)?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Strip store-specific noise (brand prefixes, sizes, "no salt added") with per-store rules from config.
2. Run the canonical matcher; queue low-confidence lines in the review UI's order-lines tab.
3. Confirmations add aliases shared with recipe matching.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; most sample lines auto-match after one review session.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
